Method of Attack: Malicious Microsoft Word document with macros
Attack Vector: Malicious Microsoft Word document delivered inside a ZIP file
Indicators of Compromise: Digitally signed certificates published by Certum

Sample document file names: Malaysia Shipment.docx, Jakarta Shipment.docx, malta containers.docx, Certified documents.docx, Notarized Documents.docx, bank statement.docx, passport and documents.docx, Case Draft.docx, documents scan.docx
